hosting: Owner's Windows computer; no hosting subscription
availability: Computer powered on, connected and Windows signed in; manual sleep and shutdown stop service
scope: Live read-only HTTP, PostgreSQL and official Telegram Bot API; not a Telegram client upload acceptance check

at_rest.method: Windows EFS; user certificate key stored separately in Windows

remaining: Real Telegram upload/report/FixLab/Watch acceptance by a human; controlled handler/API checks are separate
Windows reboot/sign-in was not simulated as an actual reboot
No uptime SLA or public traffic capacity benchmark
